## Schemas introduced by this capability

4 schema(s) exist only when `octo/extras` is active.

### `ExtraItem`

- **id** (string (uuid), optional): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **uuid** (string, optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **resellerReference** (string, optional, nullable): Reseller reference value. Example: `"RES-BOOK-10045"`.
- **supplierReference** (string, optional, nullable): Supplier reference value. Example: `"SUP-BOOK-7782"`.
- **extraId** (string, optional): Extra identifier for the reserved extra. Example: `"extra_3d6f0a3a-59d4-4b16-a0c5-11d2d8a4e6b7"`.
- **retail** (integer, optional, nullable): Confirmed custom retail amount in minor units for this extra item when the extra uses custom retail pricing. Example: `1500`.
- **status** (string, optional): Current status value. Possible values: `ON_HOLD`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED`, `REDEEMED`, `NO_SHOW`, `PENDING`, `REJECTED`, `REBOOKED`, `QUOTE` (the specification declares this set on `Booking`; here it types the field as a plain string). Example: `"CONFIRMED"`.
- **utcRedeemedAt** (string (date-time), optional, nullable): Utc redeemed at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **contact** (Contact, optional): Contact object.
- **visibleContactFields** (string[], optional): List of visible contact field values. Example: `["fullName", "emailAddress"]`.
- **requiredContactFields** (string[], optional): List of required contact field values. Example: `["fullName", "emailAddress"]`.
- **ticket** (Ticket, optional): Ticket object.
- **pricing** (Pricing, optional): Pricing object.
- **offerCode** (string, optional, nullable): Offer code value. Example: `"SUMMER25"`.
- **offerTitle** (string, optional, nullable): Offer title value. Example: `"Summer Promotion"`.
- **offerIsCombination** (boolean, optional): Whether offer is combination is enabled. Example: `true`.
- **offerComparisons** (OfferComparison[], optional): List of offer comparison values.

### `ExtraItemRequest`

Required: `extraId`.

- **uuid** (string, optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **extraId** (string (uuid), required): Extra UUID to reserve. Send one `extraItems[]` object per reserved extra. Example: `"3d6f0a3a-59d4-4b16-a0c5-11d2d8a4e6b7"`.
- **retail** (integer, optional): Custom retail amount in minor units. Required when the selected extra has `customRetail: true`. Example: `1500`.
- **resellerReference** (string, optional): Reseller reference value. Example: `"RES-BOOK-10045"`.

### `ExtraPricing`

Required: `currency`, `currencyPrecision`, `extraId`, `original`, `retail`.

- **currency** (string, required): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **currencyPrecision** (integer, required): Number of decimal places for currency amounts. Example: `2`.
- **extraId** (string, required): Extra identifier. Example: `"extra_fast_track"`.
- **net** (integer, optional, nullable): Net amount in minor units after discounts. In booking responses, this is the amount the supplier invoices for the booking. Example: `18000`.
- **original** (integer, required): Original amount in minor units before discounts. Example: `22000`.
- **retail** (integer, required): Retail amount in minor units after discounts. In booking responses, this is the amount you should charge the guest for the booking. Example: `20000`.

### `ExtraRestrictions`

- **default** (boolean, optional): Whether this extra is selected by default. Example: `false`.
- **idRequired** (boolean, optional): Whether guest identification is required for this extra. Example: `false`.
- **maxCustomRetail** (integer, optional, nullable): Maximum allowed custom retail amount in minor units when `customRetail` is `true`. If `octo/pricing` is also enabled and a `currency` is selected, this value is returned in that currency. Example: `5000`.
- **maxQuantity** (integer, optional): Maximum quantity allowed for this extra. Example: `1`.
- **minCustomRetail** (integer, optional): Minimum allowed custom retail amount in minor units when `customRetail` is `true`. If `octo/pricing` is also enabled and a `currency` is selected, this value is returned in that currency. Example: `500`.
- **minQuantity** (integer, optional): Minimum quantity required for this extra. Example: `1`.
- **paxCount** (integer, optional): Number of passengers this extra applies to. Example: `0`.
- **required** (boolean, optional): Whether this extra is required. Example: `false`.
- **accompaniedBy** (string[], optional): List of unit or extra identifiers that must be selected with this extra. Example: `[]`.
- **accompaniedByRatio** (integer, optional, nullable): Numerator for any accompanying selection ratio.
- **accompaniedByRatioDenominator** (integer, optional, nullable): Denominator for any accompanying selection ratio.
- **notAccompaniedBy** (string[], optional): List of unit or extra identifiers that cannot be selected with this extra. Example: `[]`.

## Integration notes

From [docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/extras](https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/extras).

### Two quantity limits, two error codes

Extras exist at booking level and at unit level, each with its own configured limit:

- `EXTRAS_QTY_LIMIT` — a booking-level extra exceeded its limit.
- `EXTRAS_UNIT_QTY_LIMIT` — a unit-level extra exceeded its limit.

Availability requests take `extras[]` entries of `id` and `quantity`, so you can price a selection
before booking.

### Custom retail extras: you set the price

A few extras use **reseller-supplied pricing**, flagged by `customRetail: true` on the extra object.
A gratuity is the typical case. For those:

- include `retail` **in minor units** on availability `extras[]`,
- include `retail` **in minor units** on booking `extraItems[]`,
- offer `customRetailOptions` as suggested values when present,
- enforce `restrictions.minCustomRetail` and `restrictions.maxCustomRetail` client-side.

Four errors come back when this is done wrong: `EXTRAS_RETAIL_REQUIRED`,
`EXTRAS_RETAIL_BELOW_MINIMUM`, `EXTRAS_RETAIL_ABOVE_MAXIMUM`, and the quantity limits above.

With `octo/pricing` enabled and a `currency` selected, custom retail amounts come back in that
currency's minor units — so the value you send and the value you read use the same scale.

### With octo/pricing

Availability pricing then includes both extra pricing breakdowns and totals. Note the naming: **the
"from" payloads use `extraPricingFrom`, not `extraPricing`** — same shape, indicative price.

### Where extras appear

Three levels, and the level decides the quantity limit that applies:

- **`option.extras[]`** — extras offered for the whole booking.
- **`unit.extras[]`** — extras offered per unit type.
- **`booking.extraItems[]`** — what the guest actually chose, on the booking.

Extra IDs follow the form `extra_<uuid>`. Availability requests take `extras[]` of `id` and
`quantity`; bookings take `extraItems[]`.

The documentation shows the custom-retail shape on four schemas — `Option`, `AvailabilityRequest`,
`Booking` and `BookingWriteRequest` — because a custom-retail extra has to carry its `retail` on
both the pricing call and the write call.
